ms.promise: Developed API connection to Atala PRISM, implemented DID-based voting features tied to Atala PRISM. Developed Voting power features.
ms.criteria: A reviewer can see that the code is in the github repository. A list of known issues is available. The code is ready for review and testing.
ms.report:
The Codebase changes for this milestone are located here:
https://github.com/SundaeSwap-finance/atala-go
During this work phase we completed the connection between the Sundae Governance module and ProofSpace's Atala Prism interface. We were able to use Catalyst Town Hall DIDs issued by Darlington as a gateway to accept a vote on the Sundae governance platform.
The work flow is: User enters Sundae Governance site > Expresses their intent on the voting actions > Is presented with a QR code > Scans QR Code on ProofSpace Wallet > Agrees to submit proof of Town Hall attendance > Vote is pushed through to the GO Webhook with all of the user's shared identity information and their ballot choice.
During the same time frame, The Cardano Foundation released a new identity wallet. We attended an introductory meeting with the Cardano Foundation and their wallet team. At this time, their wallet is not utilizing Atala Prism, that work still needs to be completed. So we aren't able to add their wallet at this time for this particular project, but we are considering a future feature addition to add their wallet to the architecture.
We made this architecture extensible. ProofSpace has it's own component, and other wallets can also be added this way. We believe that a CIP may be necessary to provide a good guidance to all identity wallet providers, so that we can have a more universal experience for the future. For now, we will continue with our current architecture.
